summary: SwiftData is a declarative object-graph layer over a store: @Model classes, ModelContainer and ModelContext, predicate queries, relationships, undo, history and iCloud sync. BifrOSt has no model layer or database-backed store and no SDK API for one; apps persist with flat files, a key-value defaults file, JSON restoration state and an in-memory undo manager, which cover some pieces of the same job but not the model, query or sync parts.

gaps: No model layer: no declarative model type, schema, or SDK-level container and context for persistent objects.
No queryable record store: no predicate or sort-descriptor fetch over persistent records, and no live results that update views.
No relationships, uniqueness or index constraints between stored records.
No pluggable data store interface and no store-level batching.
No change history or transaction tokens for records, so history-based sync cannot be built on SDK APIs.
No iCloud or cross-device sync API for app model data.
Undo records only what the app registers; there is no automatic capture of store changes as SwiftData's undo manager does.
